body.statement: For each fixed \(\alpha\in(0,1)\), the constant \(C_{\mathrm W}(B,c,\alpha)<\infty\) may be chosen so that \[\inf_{(G_n,Y_n)\in\mathcal M_n(d;B,c)}\mathbb P_U(\tau_n\in C_{n,\alpha})\ge1-\alpha-2K_n(d;B,c)-C_{\mathrm W}(B,c,\alpha)(d/n)^{1/3}.\] Hence, if \(d_n=o(n^{2/3})\), then \(\liminf_n\inf_{\mathcal M_n(d_n;B,c)}\mathbb P_U(\tau_n\in C_{n,\alpha})\ge1-\alpha\).
body.justification: This expanded-regime coverage statement is a candidate downstream consequence of the unverified normal and ratio bounds.
body.gap: Corollary 5.7 of \cite{KandirosPipisDaskalakisHarshaw2024CGD} covers only its \(o(n^{1/9})\) pointwise regime.
body.consumer: If proved, it would provide the CGD calibration rule for the concrete direct-effect inquiry in Declaration 18.13.
